parameters.query:
with input_data as (
    select
        nullif($1::text, '')::uuid as provided_transaction_id,
        nullif($2::text, '') as provided_business_id,
        nullif($3::text, '') as shopify_cart_id,
        nullif($4::text, '') as shopify_checkout_id,
        $5::jsonb as workflow_payload
),

resolved_by_attribute as (
    select
        t.*
    from commerce.transactions t
    inner join input_data d
        on t.id = d.provided_transaction_id
    where
        d.provided_transaction_id is not null
        and (
            d.provided_business_id is null
            or t.business_id = d.provided_business_id
        )
    limit 1
),

resolved_by_payment as (
    select
        t.*
    from commerce.payments p
    inner join commerce.transactions t
        on t.id = p.transaction_id
    inner join input_data d
        on true
    where
        p.provider = 'shopify'
        and (
            p.metadata ->> 'shopify_cart_id' = d.shopify_cart_id
            or p.provider_payment_id = d.shopify_cart_id
            or p.metadata ->> 'shopify_checkout_id' = d.shopify_checkout_id
        )
    order by p.created_at desc
    limit 1
),

resolved_transaction as (
    select to_jsonb(t) as transaction
    from resolved_by_attribute t

    union all

    select to_jsonb(t) as transaction
    from resolved_by_payment t

    limit 1
)

select
    case
        when exists (
            select 1
            from resolved_transaction
        )
        then true
        else false
    end as transaction_found,

    (
        select transaction
        from resolved_transaction
        limit 1
    ) as transaction,

    d.workflow_payload

from input_data d;

insert into commerce.events (
    transaction_id,
    event_type,
    source,
    status,
    payload,
    processed_at
)
values (
    null,
    'shopify_payment_webhook_unmatched',
    'DALIA_M5_EVT_Shopify_Payment',
    'received',
    $1::jsonb,
    now()
)
returning id as event_id;
